final: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, average_ratio, ABS(average_ratio - AVG(average_ratio) OVER ()) AS distance_from_mean FROM type_averages ORDER BY event_type
